seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions | VISH Studio
seo.description: Answers to common questions about working with VISH Studio on digital strategy, design, development, and automation.

label: FAQ
faqSubtext: Clear answers for founders, operators, and teams considering social media marketing, websites, digital products, or AI automation with VISH Studio.

faqItems.question: 1. What does VISH Studio do?
faqItems.answer: We help businesses with social media marketing, websites, SaaS products, custom software, mobile applications, branding, website templates, and AI integrations & automations.

faqItems.question: 2. Where is VISH Studio based?
faqItems.answer: VISH Studio is based in Mauritius and works with both local and international clients.

faqItems.question: 3. What types of businesses do you work with?
faqItems.answer: We work with startups, SMEs, established businesses and organisations that want to improve how they present themselves, operate or serve their customers digitally.

faqItems.question: 4. What makes VISH Studio different from a traditional web agency?
faqItems.answer: Our team combines business strategy, UX/UI design, branding and engineering so that decisions are made around the overall business objective.

faqItems.question: 5. Can VISH Studio validate an idea before we build it?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we begin with discovery, product architecture, user flows and prototyping before moving into full development.

faqItems.question: 6. Can VISH Studio work with our existing team?
faqItems.answer: Yes. VISH Studio can collaborate with internal marketing teams, developers, product teams, founders or other stakeholders depending on the structure of the project.

faqItems.question: 7. Still have a question?
faqItems.answer: Every project is different. If you're exploring a new website, brand, SaaS platform, mobile application, custom software project or digital automation, schedule a free discovery call with VISH Studio, or reach out to us on email.
